notes.subject: bel he paia
notes.rationale: אפים em i literally 'narapl' / 'nose', idiom bilong bel he — tok Tasol i no save

notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח em i ruak — win, win bilong bel, Spirit — D2 lo i tambuim 'spirit' tasol

notes.subject: טוב ... מן
notes.rationale: Hebrew i tok 'gutpela ... bilong' (comparative מִן), Tok Pisin i gat 'moa long'

translation: Man i save holim pas long bel he paia em i gutpela moa long bikpela man i gat strong, na man i bosim ⟨את⟩ ruak bilong en i gutpela moa long man i kisim ⟨את⟩ siti.

tokens.gloss: man i save holim pas long
i gutpela moa long man i kisim
